statement: On the observed ABSD boot, at the instant the kernel serves frame_stats, is the frame allocator's headroom below one eighth of its capacity?
subject: one ABSD boot, named by its boot clock id pulse-absd-boot:sha256:<hex(sha256(16-byte kernel boot id))>
unavailable: the kernel refuses frame_stats, or the record fails its checks (frame_bytes != 4096, free+allocated == 0, capacity == 0, allocated > limit): the producer emits no evidence and the resolver answers unknown; no count is ever substituted
